result.summary: Found 1 major content issue: a food image has poorly masked, unnatural-looking elements.

issues.description: The food image for 'Green Bowl Poké' has poorly masked elements. The red and green ingredients appear as jagged, flat cutouts pasted onto the plate background, making the dish look unnatural and visually broken.
issues.suggestion: Replace the image with a high-quality photograph of the dish that does not use artificial or poorly masked cutouts.
